s1.syndrome_frame: A painful polypoid mass on the gingiva with bone resorption and atypical cells
salient_findings: 10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
Atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells on biopsy
key_facts: 69-year-old Japanese man
Pain and mass on the left lower gingiva
History of chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
No tobacco or alcohol use
Trismus present
Normal vital signs
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion on intraoral inspection
Whitish pseudomembrane covering the lesion
Mandibular bone destruction on contrast-enhanced CT
Biopsy showed loose granulation tissue with atypical cells
Spindle cells had basophilic cytoplasm, bizarre nuclei, and atypical mitoses
Immunohistochemical staining positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
Ki-67 labeling index approximately 50%
